node.statement: If S_N converges in B to f(X) and T_N=iota_n(S_N) for every N, then the isometry iota_n is continuous, so T_N converges to iota_n(f(X)); since the power-series definition identifies the same T_N-limit as f(iota_n(X)), uniqueness of limits gives both definedness and f(iota_n(X))=iota_n(f(X)).
